entry.en: The passport must have been issued less than 10 years before arrival, and some passports renewed before 1 October 2018 might be invalid.
entry.es: El pasaporte debe haberse emitido hace menos de 10 años antes de la llegada, y algunos renovados antes del 1 de octubre de 2018 podrían no ser válidos.
entry.quote: have a ‘date of issue’ less than 10 years before the date you arrive – if you renewed your passport before 1 October 2018, it might have a date of issue that is more than 10 years ago, making it invalid for entry to the Schengen area

entry.en: The passport must expire at least 3 months after the day you plan to leave the Schengen area.
entry.es: El pasaporte debe vencer al menos 3 meses después del día en que planea salir del espacio Schengen.
entry.quote: have an ‘expiry date’ at least 3 months after the day you plan to leave the Schengen area

entry.en: At Czech border control you may need to show a return or onward ticket and prove you have enough money for your stay.
entry.es: En el control fronterizo checo puede que le pidan un billete de vuelta o de continuación y que demuestre que tiene dinero suficiente para su estancia.
entry.quote:
At Czech border control, you may also need to:

- show a return or onward ticket

- prove that you have enough money for your stay – the amount varies depending on your accommodation

entry.en: Without a Czech residence permit you must register your address with the nearest foreign police department within 3 days of arriving.
entry.es: Sin permiso de residencia checo debe registrar su dirección en el departamento de policía de extranjeros más cercano en los 3 días siguientes a la llegada.
entry.quote: If you do not have a Czech residence permit, you must register your address with the nearest foreign police department (in Czech) within 3 days of arriving

entry.en: Cash or travellers cheques worth 10,000 euros or more must be declared, or the money could be seized when you leave.
entry.es: El efectivo o los cheques de viaje por 10.000 euros o más deben declararse, o el dinero podría ser confiscado al salir.
entry.quote: Declare cash or travellers cheques if the value is 10,000 euros or more. You will get a certified declaration to show you brought it in with you. If you do not, your money could be seized when you leave.

entry.en: On short stays into the Schengen area you may need to register biometric details such as fingerprints and a photo, at no cost.
entry.es: En estancias cortas en el espacio Schengen puede que deba registrar datos biométricos como huellas y una foto, sin costo.
entry.quote: when you travel into the Schengen area for short stays, you may need to register your biometric details, such as fingerprints and a photo. There is no cost for EES registration.

safety.en: Petty theft is a problem in major tourist areas in Prague, with pickpocketing risk on busy metro and bus routes from the airport.
safety.es: El hurto es un problema en las zonas turísticas de Praga, con riesgo de carteristas en las rutas de metro y autobús desde el aeropuerto.
safety.quote:
Petty theft is a problem, especially in major tourist areas in Prague. There is a risk of pickpocketing:

- on busy metro and bus routes from Prague airport to the city centre

safety.en: Beware of criminals posing as plainclothes police who ask to see your foreign currency and passport, which Czech police have no right to do.
safety.es: Cuidado con delincuentes que se hacen pasar por policías de civil y piden ver su moneda extranjera y pasaporte, algo que la policía checa no tiene derecho a hacer.
safety.quote: Beware of criminals pretending to be plainclothes policemen who ask to see your foreign currency and passport. Czech police officers do not have the right to do this.

safety.en: There is a risk of drink spiking in bars and clubs, so do not take drinks from strangers or leave yours unattended.
safety.es: Hay riesgo de que adulteren las bebidas en bares y discotecas, así que no acepte bebidas de extraños ni deje la suya sin vigilar.
safety.quote: There is a risk of drink spiking in bars and clubs. Be careful not to take drinks from strangers or leave your drinks unattended.

safety.en: Prague city police advise changing money at a currency exchange or bank rather than on the street, as street money is often counterfeit.
safety.es: La policía de Praga aconseja cambiar dinero en una casa de cambio o banco y no en la calle, pues ese dinero suele ser falso.
safety.quote: always change money at a currency exchange or bank rather than on the street as this money is often counterfeit

safety.en: Terrorist attacks in Czechia cannot be ruled out.
safety.es: No se pueden descartar atentados terroristas en Chequia.
safety.quote: Terrorist attacks in Czechia cannot be ruled out.

safety.en: Expect severe penalties, including long jail sentences and heavy fines, for possessing, using or smuggling illegal drugs, with sentences of up to 18 years.
safety.es: Se esperan penas severas, con largas condenas y fuertes multas, por poseer, consumir o traficar drogas ilegales, con penas de hasta 18 años.
safety.quote: You should expect severe penalties such as a long jail sentence and heavy fines for possessing, using or smuggling illegal drugs, including when transiting through the airport. Convictions carry sentences of up to 18 years.

health.en: Tap water is safe to drink and is especially good in Prague.
health.es: El agua del grifo es segura para beber y es especialmente buena en Praga.
health.quote: Tap water is safe to drink. It's especially good in Prague

health.en: Parts of the Czech Republic have ticks that can carry encephalitis or Lyme borreliosis.
health.es: Partes de República Checa tienen garrapatas que pueden transmitir encefalitis o borreliosis de Lyme.
health.quote: Central Europe and parts of the Czech Republic have ticks (Ixodes ricinus) which can carry Encephalitis or Lyme Borreliosis.

health.en: Vaccination against encephalitis is available and recommended.
health.es: La vacuna contra la encefalitis está disponible y se recomienda.
health.quote: Vaccination against Encephalitis is available and recommended.

health.en: Over-the-counter drugs such as aspirin are sold at pharmacies (lékárna), usually open Monday to Friday 08:00-19:00, not at grocery stores.
health.es: Los medicamentos sin receta como la aspirina se venden en farmacias (lékárna), normalmente abiertas de lunes a viernes de 08:00 a 19:00, no en tiendas de comestibles.
health.quote: Grocery stores do not sell over-the-counter drugs, such as aspirin.  You will need to go to a pharmacy (lékárna), which is usually open M-F 08:00-19:00

health.en: Most doctors speak some English and the level of care is of a very high standard.
health.es: La mayoría de los médicos habla algo de inglés y el nivel de atención es muy alto.
health.quote: Most doctors speak some English, and the level of care is of a very high standard.

health.en: Make sure you have travel insurance covering local treatment or unexpected medical evacuation.
health.es: Asegúrese de tener un seguro de viaje que cubra el tratamiento local o una evacuación médica inesperada.
health.quote: appropriate travel insurance for local treatment or unexpected medical evacuation

help.en: The emergency number in Czechia is 112 for ambulance, fire and police.
help.es: El número de emergencias en Chequia es el 112 para ambulancia, bomberos y policía.
help.quote:
Emergency services in Czechia

Telephone: 112 (ambulance, fire, police)

help.en: You may also dial 150 for the fire brigade, 155 for a medical emergency or 158 for the police.
help.es: También puede marcar el 150 para bomberos, el 155 para emergencias médicas o el 158 para la policía.
help.quote: You may also dial 150 for the fire brigade, 155 in a medical emergency or 158 for the police.

help.en: Report thefts in person to the nearest Czech police station within 24 hours and get a crime report number for insurance.
help.es: Denuncie los robos en persona en la comisaría checa más cercana en 24 horas y obtenga un número de denuncia para el seguro.
help.quote: Report thefts in person to the nearest Czech police station within 24 hours and get a police report crime number for insurance purposes.

help.en: The Prague police station at Jungmannovo namesti 9 is open 24 hours a day and would provide English speaking interpreters.
help.es: La comisaría de Praga en Jungmannovo namesti 9 está abierta las 24 horas y ofrecería intérpretes de inglés.
help.quote: Prague police station (Jungmannovo namesti 9, Prague 1, nearest metro stop is Mustek) is open 24 hours a day and would provide English speaking interpreters.

help.en: Every lamppost in Prague has a 6-digit number at eye level that helps you tell the police where you are.
help.es: Cada farola de Praga tiene un número de 6 dígitos a la altura de los ojos que ayuda a indicar a la policía dónde está.
help.quote: Every lamppost in Prague has a 6-digit number posted at eye level. These codes will help you tell the police where you are if you cannot give them an exact address.

getting_in.en: Václav Havel Airport (PRG) is about 10 km west of the centre of Prague.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto Václav Havel (PRG) está a unos 10 km al oeste del centro de Praga.
getting_in.quote: Václav Havel Airport (PRG IATA) – about 10 km west of the centre of Prague (Praha in Czech).

getting_in.en: Other international airports are Brno Tuřany, Leoš Janáček (Ostrava), Pardubice, Karlovy Vary and České Budějovice.
getting_in.es: Otros aeropuertos internacionales son Brno Tuřany, Leoš Janáček (Ostrava), Pardubice, Karlovy Vary y České Budějovice.
getting_in.quote:
Other international airports are (descending in importance):

2 Brno Tuřany Airport
3 Leoš Janáček Airport (Ostrava)
4 Pardubice airport
5 Karlovy Vary airport and the new
6 České Budějovice airport.

getting_in.en: International buses run from many European cities, with direct connections from Germany, Poland, the Netherlands, Slovakia, Switzerland and Austria.
getting_in.es: Hay autobuses internacionales desde muchas ciudades europeas, con conexiones directas desde Alemania, Polonia, Países Bajos, Eslovaquia, Suiza y Austria.
getting_in.quote: International bus service runs from many cities in Europe with direct connections from Germany, Poland, Netherlands, Slovakia, Switzerland, Austria, etc.

getting_in.en: EC trains run every two hours from Berlin or Hamburg via Dresden and Bad Schandau to Prague and Brno.
getting_in.es: Los trenes EC salen cada dos horas desde Berlín o Hamburgo vía Dresde y Bad Schandau hacia Praga y Brno.
getting_in.quote: EC trains operate every two hours from Berlin or Hamburg via Dresden and Bad Schandau in Saxon Switzerland to Prague and Brno.

getting_in.en: Trains between Czechia and Slovakia are frequent.
getting_in.es: Los trenes entre Chequia y Eslovaquia son frecuentes.
getting_in.quote: As parts of former Czechoslovakia, the trains between Czechia and Slovakia are frequent.

getting_in.en: The country has land borders with Austria, Germany, Poland and Slovakia.
getting_in.es: El país tiene fronteras terrestres con Austria, Alemania, Polonia y Eslovaquia.
getting_in.quote: The country has land borders with Austria, Germany, Poland and Slovakia.

getting_around.en: Jízdní řády Seznam and the IDOS app cover all Czech trains, buses and city transport and many lines abroad.
getting_around.es: Jízdní řády Seznam y la app IDOS cubren todos los trenes, autobuses y transporte urbano checos y muchas líneas en el extranjero.
getting_around.quote:
Find your connections on one of following websites:

Jízdní řády Seznam
Public Transport IDOS (Mobile App)
Both sites cover all Czech trains, buses and city transport and many train and bus lines abroad.

getting_around.en: Buses from FlixBus, RegioJet, Leo Express and Student Agency are usually a bit faster and cheaper than Czech trains between Prague and major cities.
getting_around.es: Los autobuses de FlixBus, RegioJet, Leo Express y Student Agency suelen ser algo más rápidos y baratos que los trenes checos entre Praga y las grandes ciudades.
getting_around.quote: A cheap and excellent means of travelling between Prague and other major cities are the buses from FlixBus, RegioJet, Leo Express and Student Agency. These buses are usually a bit faster and cost less than the Czech trains (not considering discounts).

getting_around.en: You must validate your ticket in a ticket machine before starting a journey on public transport.
getting_around.es: Debe validar su billete en una máquina antes de iniciar un viaje en transporte público.
getting_around.quote: You must validate your ticket in a ticket machine before starting a journey on public transport.

getting_around.en: Ride-hailing is available, with Bolt in many towns and Uber in Prague and Brno.
getting_around.es: Hay transporte con aplicación: Bolt en muchas ciudades y Uber en Praga y Brno.
getting_around.quote:
Ride-hailing is available in Czech Republic and the following are the most anticipated providers:

 Bolt. Includes many towns. (updated Jul 2020)
 Uber. Works in Prague and Brno.

getting_around.en: To drive on motorways you need to buy a vignette unless you are riding a motorcycle.
getting_around.es: Para circular por autopistas hay que comprar una viñeta, salvo en motocicleta.
getting_around.quote: In order to drive on the well-kept motorways, however, you need to purchase a vignette unless you're riding a motorcycle.

getting_around.en: Czechia is a zero tolerance country for alcohol, and driving under the influence of any amount of alcohol or other drugs is illegal.
getting_around.es: Chequia tiene tolerancia cero con el alcohol, y conducir bajo los efectos de cualquier cantidad de alcohol u otras drogas es ilegal.
getting_around.quote: The Czech Republic is a zero tolerance country for alcohol. It's illegal to drive a motor vehicle under the influence of any amount of alcohol (or other drugs)

money.en: The currency of Czechia is the koruna (crown), symbol Kč, ISO code CZK.
money.es: La moneda de Chequia es la corona (koruna), símbolo Kč, código ISO CZK.
money.quote: The currency of the Czech republic is the koruna (crown), plural koruny or korun, denoted by the symbol "Kč" (ISO code: CZK).

money.en: Some major stores accept euros and accommodation often quotes prices in euros, but the exchange rate is often quite bad.
money.es: Algunas tiendas grandes aceptan euros y los alojamientos suelen cotizar en euros, pero el tipo de cambio suele ser bastante malo.
money.quote: Some major stores (mainly bigger chains) will accept euros, and it's also fairly common for accommodation providers to quote the price in euros. Often the exchange rate is quite bad.

money.en: Never exchange money on the street, as you are likely to get worthless expired Belarusian rubles or Bulgarian leva.
money.es: Nunca cambie dinero en la calle, pues es probable que le den rublos bielorrusos o levas búlgaras caducados y sin valor.
money.quote: Never exchange money on the street, as these people are likely to give you similar-looking but worthless expired Belarusian rubles or Bulgarian leva instead.

money.en: Decline conversion into your debit card's currency at ATMs, because there is a fee for it, usually 12-15% of the total amount.
money.es: Rechace la conversión a la moneda de su tarjeta de débito en cajeros, porque tiene una comisión, normalmente del 12 al 15% del total.
money.quote: Decline the conversation into the currency of your debit card, because there is a fee for doing so (usually 12–15% of the total amount).

money.en: Major stores throughout the country accept Visa and Maestro cards, as do all tourist stores in Prague.
money.es: Las tiendas grandes de todo el país aceptan tarjetas Visa y Maestro, igual que todas las tiendas turísticas de Praga.
money.quote: Major stores throughout the country accept Visa and Electronic Cash / Maestro Cards, as do all the tourist stores in Prague.

money.en: Tipping in tourist restaurants is a standard 10% and is not normally added to the bill.
money.es: La propina en restaurantes turísticos es un 10% estándar y normalmente no se añade a la cuenta.
money.quote: Tipping in tourist restaurants is a standard 10%, and is not normally added to the bill.

etiquette.en: Always say hello (Dobrý den) and goodbye (Na shledanou) when entering and leaving a small shop, as it is polite.
etiquette.es: Diga siempre hola (Dobrý den) y adiós (Na shledanou) al entrar y salir de una tienda pequeña, es cortés.
etiquette.quote: Always say hello (Dobrý den) and goodbye (Na shledanou) when you enter and leave a small shop, as it is polite.

etiquette.en: When entering a Czech household, always remove your shoes.
etiquette.es: Al entrar en un hogar checo, quítese siempre los zapatos.
etiquette.quote: When entering a Czech household, always remove your shoes.

etiquette.en: The text advises answering "Central Europe", not Eastern, when a Czech asks what part of Europe their country is in.
etiquette.es: El texto aconseja responder "Europa Central", no del Este, cuando un checo pregunta en qué parte de Europa está su país.
etiquette.quote: many will even pre-empt the ignorance of some foreigners by asking "What part of Europe would you say the Czech Republic is in?" Get on their good side by answering "Central Europe", not Eastern!

etiquette.en: Czechs are fairly reserved, respect personal space and do not usually greet strangers unless introduced.
etiquette.es: Los checos son bastante reservados, respetan el espacio personal y no suelen saludar a desconocidos si no los han presentado.
etiquette.quote: Czechs are fairly reserved and generally respect others' personal space, for example, Czechs do not usually greet strangers unless introduced by someone.

etiquette.en: Holocaust denial is a criminal offence punishable by up to three years in prison, and a Nazi salute in public should be avoided.
etiquette.es: Negar el Holocausto es delito con hasta tres años de prisión, y debe evitarse el saludo nazi en público.
etiquette.quote: Holocaust denial and denial of atrocities committed by the Czechoslovakian communist regime are criminal offences punishable by up to three years of imprisonment. For similar reasons, do not perform a Nazi salute in public.

etiquette.en: Using former German names for Czech places when asking directions may cause confusion and may be regarded as offensive.
etiquette.es: Usar los antiguos nombres alemanes de lugares checos al pedir indicaciones puede causar confusión y ser considerado ofensivo.
etiquette.quote: Mentioning Czech towns and places with their former German names, when asking for directions (e.g. referring to Budweis instead of České Budějovice) may cause confusion and may be regarded as offensive and disrespectful towards the Czech people.

connectivity.en: Coverage of the three major networks (T-Mobile, Vodafone and O2) is mostly excellent throughout the country.
connectivity.es: La cobertura de las tres redes principales (T-Mobile, Vodafone y O2) es mayormente excelente en todo el país.
connectivity.quote: Cellular network coverage of the three major networks (T-Mobile, Vodafone, and O2) is mostly excellent throughout the country.

connectivity.en: 4G is available in the huge majority of the country, with much 5G coverage primarily in urban areas and corridors.
connectivity.es: El 4G está disponible en la gran mayoría del país, con buena parte del 5G principalmente en zonas urbanas y corredores.
connectivity.quote: 4G (LTE) is available in the huge majority of the country, including the countryside, with much 5G coverage primarily in urban areas and corridors.

connectivity.en: If roaming is too expensive you can buy an anonymous prepaid card from any of the three main operators.
connectivity.es: Si el roaming es muy caro, puede comprar una tarjeta prepago anónima en cualquiera de los tres operadores principales.
connectivity.quote: If you find using roaming with your own operator too expensive or you want to have a Czech phone number, you can buy an anonymous prepaid card from any of the three main operators.

connectivity.en: Operators use the 900 and 1800MHz GSM bands, which might not be compatible with some US phones operating on 1900MHz.
connectivity.es: Los operadores usan las bandas GSM de 900 y 1800 MHz, que podrían no ser compatibles con algunos teléfonos de EE. UU. de 1900 MHz.
connectivity.quote: Mobile network operators use the 900 and 1800MHz GSM frequency bands, which might not be compatible with some US phones operating on 1900MHz.

connectivity.en: Wi-Fi is available in many restaurants and most cafés, especially in larger cities.
connectivity.es: Hay Wi-Fi en muchos restaurantes y la mayoría de los cafés, sobre todo en las ciudades grandes.
connectivity.quote: Wi-Fi is available in many restaurants and most cafés, especially in larger cities.

connectivity.en: The international calling code for the Czech Republic is +420.
connectivity.es: El prefijo telefónico internacional de República Checa es +420.
connectivity.quote: The international calling code for the Czech Republic is +420.

phrases.quote: Always say hello (Dobrý den) and goodbye (Na shledanou) when you enter and leave a small shop, as it is polite.
Always say hello (Dobrý den) and goodbye (Na shledanou) when you enter and leave a small shop, as it is polite.
